observations: Used car engine and gearbox assembly.
The engine is mounted on a transmission housing.
The engine has a black plastic cover over the top.
The gearbox is attached to the engine via an orange metal bracket.
The engine has a large air intake hose and a black plastic cover.
The gearbox has a visible oil filler cap.
The item is sitting on a dirt or gravel surface in what appears to be a yard or workshop.
A watermark 'BLESSER FIELDS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: No Lexus branding or model badges are visible in the photo.
The gearbox model is not clearly legible in the photo.

risks.risk: The engine may not be a genuine Lexus 460 or may be a used part from another brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or front).

risks.risk: The gearbox may be a different model (e.g., 3ur-20) or in poor mechanical condition.
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox's identification plate and a video of it being shifted through all gears.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal damage, such as seized pistons or blown head gaskets.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine running or a compression test result.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the gearbox's identification plate.
Video of the engine being started and running.
Photo of the transmission oil filler cap to check for leaks.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
